pound.desc: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

scratch.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

teleport.desc: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.

night-shade.desc: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.

mimic.desc: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

screech.desc: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target’s Defense stat.

double-team.desc: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

recover.desc: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

harden.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

minimize.desc: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

smokescreen.desc: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target’s accuracy.

confuse-ray.desc: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

vice-grip.desc: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

withdraw.desc: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

defense-curl.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

barrier.desc: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

light-screen.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

haze.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

reflect.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

focus-energy.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

bide.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

metronome.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

mirror-move.desc: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.

guillotine.desc: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

self-destruct.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

egg-bomb.desc: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

lick.desc: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

smog.desc: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

sludge.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

bone-club.desc: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.

fire-blast.desc: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

waterfall.desc: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

clamp.desc: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

swift.desc: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

razor-wind.desc: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

skull-bash.desc: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

spike-cannon.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

constrict.desc: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

amnesia.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

kinesis.desc: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target’s accuracy.

soft-boiled.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

high-jump-kick.desc: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

glare.desc: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

dream-eater.desc: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

poison-gas.desc: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

swords-dance.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

barrage.desc: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

leech-life.desc: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

lovely-kiss.desc: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

sky-attack.desc: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.

transform.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

bubble.desc: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ Speed stats.

dizzy-punch.desc: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.

spore.desc: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

flash.desc: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

psywave.desc: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

cut.desc: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

splash.desc: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

acid-armor.desc: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

crabhammer.desc: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

explosion.desc: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

fury-swipes.desc: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

bonemerang.desc: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

rest.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

rock-slide.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

hyper-fang.desc: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.

sharpen.desc: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

gust.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

conversion.desc: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

tri-attack.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.

super-fang.desc: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.

slash.desc: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

substitute.desc: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

sketch.desc: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

triple-kick.desc: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

thief.desc: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

spider-web.desc: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.

wing-attack.desc: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

mind-reader.desc: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

nightmare.desc: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

flame-wheel.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

snore.desc: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

curse.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

flail.desc: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

conversion-2.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

aeroblast.desc: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

cotton-spore.desc: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the target, harshly reducing its Speed stat.

reversal.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

whirlwind.desc: The target is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

spite.desc: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

powder-snow.desc: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.

protect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

mach-punch.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

scary-face.desc: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

feint-attack.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

sweet-kiss.desc: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

belly-drum.desc: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

sludge-bomb.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

mud-slap.desc: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

fly.desc: The user soars, then strikes its target on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

octazooka.desc: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

zap-cannon.desc: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

foresight.desc: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

destiny-bond.desc: When this move is used, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints.

perish-song.desc: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

icy-wind.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

detect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

bone-rush.desc: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

lock-on.desc: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

karate-chop.desc: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

bind.desc: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

outrage.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

sandstorm.desc: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

giga-drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

endure.desc: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

charm.desc: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is harshly lowered.

rollout.desc: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

false-swipe.desc: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

swagger.desc: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

milk-drink.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

spark.desc: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

slam.desc: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

fury-cutter.desc: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

steel-wing.desc: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

mean-look.desc: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

attract.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

sleep-talk.desc: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

heal-bell.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

return.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

present.desc: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

frustration.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

safeguard.desc: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

vine-whip.desc: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

pain-split.desc: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

sacred-fire.desc: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

magnitude.desc: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.

dynamic-punch.desc: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

megahorn.desc: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

dragon-breath.desc: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

baton-pass.desc: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

encore.desc: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

pursuit.desc: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

rapid-spin.desc: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

stomp.desc: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

sweet-scent.desc: A sweet scent that lowers the opposing team’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

iron-tail.desc: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

metal-claw.desc: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

vital-throw.desc: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

morning-sun.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

synthesis.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moonlight.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

hidden-power.desc: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

cross-chop.desc: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

twister.desc: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

double-kick.desc: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

rain-dance.desc: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

sunny-day.desc: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

crunch.desc: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

mirror-coat.desc: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

psych-up.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

extreme-speed.desc: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

ancient-power.desc: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

shadow-ball.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

future-sight.desc: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

rock-smash.desc: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

mega-kick.desc: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

whirlpool.desc: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

beat-up.desc: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

fake-out.desc: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

uproar.desc: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

stockpile.desc: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

spit-up.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the damage.

swallow.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.

heat-wave.desc: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.

hail.desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

torment.desc: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

jump-kick.desc: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

flatter.desc: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

will-o-wisp.desc: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

memento.desc: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.

facade.desc: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

focus-punch.desc: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

smelling-salts.desc: This attack inflicts double damage on a target with paralysis. It also cures the target’s paralysis, however.

follow-me.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

nature-power.desc: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

charge.desc: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

taunt.desc: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

rolling-kick.desc: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.

helping-hand.desc: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

trick.desc: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

role-play.desc: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s natural Ability.

wish.desc: One turn after this move is used, the target’s HP is restored by half the user’s maximum HP.

assist.desc: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

ingrain.desc: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

superpower.desc: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

magic-coat.desc: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

recycle.desc: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

revenge.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

sand-attack.desc: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing its accuracy.

brick-break.desc: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

yawn.desc: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

knock-off.desc: The user slaps down the target’s held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

endeavor.desc: An attack move that cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

eruption.desc: The user attacks the opposing team with explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

skill-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

imprison.desc: If the opponents know any move also known by the user, the opponents are prevented from using it.

refresh.desc: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

grudge.desc: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

snatch.desc: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the opponent attempts to use.

headbutt.desc: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. It may also make the target flinch.

secret-power.desc: The user attacks the target with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

dive.desc: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second turn. It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

arm-thrust.desc: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

camouflage.desc: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.

tail-glow.desc: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

luster-purge.desc: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

mist-ball.desc: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk.

feather-dance.desc: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

teeter-dance.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

blaze-kick.desc: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. It may also leave the target with a burn.

double-slap.desc: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

horn-attack.desc: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

mud-sport.desc: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.

ice-ball.desc: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

needle-arm.desc: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.

slack-off.desc: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

hyper-voice.desc: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

poison-fang.desc: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

crush-claw.desc: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target’s Defense.

blast-burn.desc: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

hydro-cannon.desc: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

meteor-mash.desc: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user’s Attack.

fury-attack.desc: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

astonish.desc: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

weather-ball.desc: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

aromatherapy.desc: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user’s party.

fake-tears.desc: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

air-cutter.desc: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

overheat.desc: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

odor-sleuth.desc: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit with Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

rock-tomb.desc: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target’s Speed by preventing its movement.

silver-wind.desc: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

metal-sound.desc: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

horn-drill.desc: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

grass-whistle.desc: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

tickle.desc: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

cosmic-power.desc: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

water-spout.desc: The user spouts water to damage the opposing team. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful it becomes.

signal-beam.desc: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

shadow-punch.desc: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

extrasensory.desc: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

sky-uppercut.desc: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

sand-tomb.desc: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

sheer-cold.desc: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.

tackle.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

muddy-water.desc: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ accuracy.

bullet-seed.desc: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

aerial-ace.desc: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

icicle-spear.desc: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

iron-defense.desc: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

block.desc: The user blocks the target’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

howl.desc: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

dragon-claw.desc: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

frenzy-plant.desc: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

bulk-up.desc: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

body-slam.desc: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

bounce.desc: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

mud-shot.desc: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target’s Speed.

poison-tail.desc: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

covet.desc: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target’s held item.

volt-tackle.desc: The user electrifies itself, then charges. It causes considerable damage to the user and may leave the target with paralysis.

magical-leaf.desc: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.

water-sport.desc: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

calm-mind.desc: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

leaf-blade.desc: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

dragon-dance.desc: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

wrap.desc: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

rock-blast.desc: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

shock-wave.desc: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

water-pulse.desc: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

doom-desire.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

psycho-boost.desc: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

roost.desc: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

gravity.desc: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitate.

miracle-eye.desc: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

wake-up-slap.desc: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.

hammer-arm.desc: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

take-down.desc: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. It also damages the user a little.

gyro-ball.desc: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

healing-wish.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

brine.desc: If the target’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

natural-gift.desc: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

feint.desc: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

pluck.desc: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

tailwind.desc: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

acupressure.desc: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

metal-burst.desc: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.

u-turn.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

thrash.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

close-combat.desc: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

payback.desc: If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

assurance.desc: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

embargo.desc: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

fling.desc: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

psycho-shift.desc: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

trump-card.desc: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

heal-block.desc: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

wring-out.desc: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack’s power.

power-trick.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

double-edge.desc: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

gastro-acid.desc: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

lucky-chant.desc: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.

me-first.desc: The user tries to cut ahead of the target to steal and use the target’s intended move with greater power.

copycat.desc: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

power-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

guard-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

punishment.desc: This attack’s power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

last-resort.desc: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

worry-seed.desc: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.

sucker-punch.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

tail-whip.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

toxic-spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opponent’s feet. They poison opponents that switch into battle.

heart-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

aqua-ring.desc: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

magnet-rise.desc: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

flare-blitz.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. The user sustains serious damage and may leave the target burned.

force-palm.desc: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

aura-sphere.desc: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This move is certain to hit.

rock-polish.desc: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

poison-jab.desc: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.

dark-pulse.desc: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

comet-punch.desc: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

poison-sting.desc: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

night-slash.desc: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

aqua-tail.desc: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

seed-bomb.desc: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

air-slash.desc: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

x-scissor.desc: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

bug-buzz.desc: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

dragon-pulse.desc: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

dragon-rush.desc: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

power-gem.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

drain-punch.desc: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

twineedle.desc: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. It may also poison the target.

vacuum-wave.desc: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

focus-blast.desc: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

energy-ball.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

brave-bird.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

earth-power.desc: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

switcheroo.desc: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

giga-impact.desc: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

nasty-plot.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

bullet-punch.desc: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

avalanche.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

pin-missile.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

ice-shard.desc: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

shadow-claw.desc: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

thunder-fang.desc: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

ice-fang.desc: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

fire-fang.desc: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.

shadow-sneak.desc: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

mud-bomb.desc: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

psycho-cut.desc: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

zen-headbutt.desc: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. It may also make the target flinch.

mirror-shot.desc: The user looses a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

leer.desc: The opposing team gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The opposing team’s Defense stats are reduced.

flash-cannon.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

rock-climb.desc: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.

defog.desc: A strong wind blows away the target’s obstacles such as Reflect or Light Screen. It also lowers the target’s evasiveness.

trick-room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

draco-meteor.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

discharge.desc: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

lava-plume.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

leaf-storm.desc: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

power-whip.desc: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.

rock-wrecker.desc: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

bite.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

cross-poison.desc: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also leave the target poisoned. Critical hits land more easily.

gunk-shot.desc: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

iron-head.desc: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

magnet-bomb.desc: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

stone-edge.desc: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

captivate.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

stealth-rock.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opponent’s team. The trap hurts opponents that switch into battle.

grass-knot.desc: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

chatter.desc: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the target.

judgment.desc: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

growl.desc: The user growls in an endearing way, making the opposing team less wary. The foes’ Attack stats are lowered.

bug-bite.desc: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

charge-beam.desc: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

wood-hammer.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

aqua-jet.desc: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

attack-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

defend-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

heal-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

head-smash.desc: The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

double-hit.desc: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

roar-of-time.desc: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

roar.desc: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

spacial-rend.desc: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

lunar-dance.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

crush-grip.desc: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

magma-storm.desc: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

dark-void.desc: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

seed-flare.desc: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. It may harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def.

ominous-wind.desc: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

shadow-force.desc: The user disappears, then strikes the target on the second turn. It hits even if the target protects itself.

hone-claws.desc: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

wide-guard.desc: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

sing.desc: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

guard-split.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.

power-split.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target’s.

wonder-room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

psyshock.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

venoshock.desc: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

autotomize.desc: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

rage-powder.desc: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

telekinesis.desc: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

magic-room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

smack-down.desc: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

supersonic.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

storm-throw.desc: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

flame-burst.desc: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

sludge-wave.desc: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

quiver-dance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

heavy-slam.desc: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

synchronoise.desc: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.

electro-ball.desc: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

soak.desc: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.

flame-charge.desc: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

coil.desc: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

sonic-boom.desc: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

low-sweep.desc: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

acid-spray.desc: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

foul-play.desc: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.

simple-beam.desc: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

entrainment.desc: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

after-you.desc: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

round.desc: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

echoed-voice.desc: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

chip-away.desc: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

clear-smog.desc: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

mega-punch.desc: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

disable.desc: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

stored-power.desc: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.

quick-guard.desc: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

ally-switch.desc: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

scald.desc: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

shell-smash.desc: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

heal-pulse.desc: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

hex.desc: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

sky-drop.desc: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

shift-gear.desc: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

circle-throw.desc: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

acid.desc: The opposing team is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. The acid may also lower the targets’ Sp. Def stats.

incinerate.desc: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

quash.desc: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

acrobatics.desc: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

reflect-type.desc: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.

retaliate.desc: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

final-gambit.desc: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.

bestow.desc: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.

inferno.desc: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.

water-pledge.desc: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.

fire-pledge.desc: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.

ember.desc: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.

grass-pledge.desc: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

volt-switch.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

struggle-bug.desc: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

bulldoze.desc: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.

frost-breath.desc: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

dragon-tail.desc: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

work-up.desc: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

electroweb.desc: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

wild-charge.desc: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

drill-run.desc: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

flamethrower.desc: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

dual-chop.desc: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

heart-stamp.desc: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. It may also make the target flinch.

horn-leech.desc: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

sacred-sword.desc: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

razor-shell.desc: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

heat-crash.desc: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.

leaf-tornado.desc: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.

steamroller.desc: The user crushes its targets by rolling over them with its rolled-up body. This attack may make the target flinch.

cotton-guard.desc: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.

night-daze.desc: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

mist.desc: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

psystrike.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

tail-slap.desc: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

hurricane.desc: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

head-charge.desc: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. It also damages the user a little.

gear-grind.desc: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

searing-shot.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

techno-blast.desc: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

relic-song.desc: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.

secret-sword.desc: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.

glaciate.desc: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This attack reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

water-gun.desc: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

bolt-strike.desc: The user charges its target, surrounding itself with a great amount of electricity. It may leave the target with paralysis.

blue-flare.desc: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

fiery-dance.desc: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

snarl.desc: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.

icicle-crash.desc: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.

fusion-flare.desc: The user brings down a giant flame. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.

fusion-bolt.desc: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous flame.

hydro-pump.desc: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

surf.desc: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

ice-beam.desc: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

blizzard.desc: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

pay-day.desc: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

psybeam.desc: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

bubble-beam.desc: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the opposing team. It may also lower their Speed stats.

aurora-beam.desc: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

hyper-beam.desc: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

peck.desc: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

drill-peck.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

submission.desc: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

low-kick.desc: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier targets.

counter.desc: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

seismic-toss.desc: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

fire-punch.desc: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may also leave the target with a burn.

strength.desc: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

absorb.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

mega-drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

leech-seed.desc: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

growth.desc: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

razor-leaf.desc: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

solar-beam.desc: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

poison-powder.desc: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

stun-spore.desc: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may leave the target with paralysis.

sleep-powder.desc: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

ice-punch.desc: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.

petal-dance.desc: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

string-shot.desc: The targets are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. This silk reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

dragon-rage.desc: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

fire-spin.desc: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

thunder-shock.desc: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderbolt.desc: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-wave.desc: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

thunder.desc: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

rock-throw.desc: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

earthquake.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes those around it.

thunder-punch.desc: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

fissure.desc: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

dig.desc: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

toxic.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

confusion.desc: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

psychic.desc: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

hypnosis.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

meditate.desc: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

agility.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

quick-attack.desc: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

rage.desc: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

freeze-shock.desc: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. It may leave the target with paralysis.

ice-burn.desc: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.

v-create.desc: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. It lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

struggle.desc: An attack that is used when no other move has PP left.
